upload.datumHelp: All surfaces of a site must use the same height reference.
upload.accuracyHelp: From the supplier's report. Typical: drone 0.05–0.10, sub-metre satellite 0.3–0.5.
upload.limit: Up to {{mb}} MB. The file must have its CRS embedded.
upload.cameraHelp: Leave the camera files empty when the camera model is embedded in the images.
upload.stereoLimit: Up to {{mb}} MB per file. Heights are produced above the WGS84 ellipsoid and converted to the site's reference.
